_comment: Boss lairs a LegionWareX pirate chart can lead to (structure, the bosses living there). Lairs whose mod isn't installed are skipped. Skarrier's Tunnel Gore lair isn't one: it's underground and in nearly every stretch of land, so every chart would lead to it.

lairs.why: The Corrupted Champion, summoned at the altar by night with a full vial of blood and the three bone staff pieces.
Forests. The Queen of Orchid, at the orchid altar.
The Black Charro, summoned at the Altar of the Dead.
Illager Invasion's Invoker lives in woodland mansions.
